summary: Iteration 7 tested the ephemeral End & Bill snapshot across public backend APIs and UI. The requested core flow passes: finalize-preview returns a fresh non-persisted freeze_snapshot; reopening after cancel increases duration/table charge; /end and Bill use the submitted snapshot; split payment, whole-rupee rounding, sticky footer, precision, permission revocation, frames, and notifications regressions passed in the 33-test suite. Two backend integrity defects were additionally reproduced: /end trusts tampered snapshots, and running frames auto-close at now rather than the frozen timestamp.

critical.issue: freeze_snapshot is an untyped dict and client values are trusted without validation. A staff request with duration_minutes=-60 and table_amount=-100 returned 200, persisted a completed negative invoice, and created a negative cash payment.

When a frame is running, it is auto-closed using now_utc() before the supplied freeze_snapshot is applied. After waiting 3 seconds between preview and confirm, invoice table_amount stayed frozen but the frame end_time/amount advanced, so itemized frame charges no longer reconcile with Table Charge.

minor.issue: Auth-hardening regression remains out of current feature scope: application access/refresh httpOnly cookies are absent; six bad passwords all return 401 and a subsequent valid login returns 200 (no lockout).
Preflight returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * without credential support rather than an explicit credentialed origin.
Existing admin password is not reconciled with ADMIN_PASSWORD; login_attempts collection/index is absent. Bcrypt $2b$, unique users.email, and password reset TTL checks pass.

Two pre-existing active legacy sessions in MongoDB still contain preview_* fields. New finalize-preview calls do not write them and strip them from that response, but direct GET strips nothing; the requested GET guarantee only holds for newly clean documents unless a migration/unset is performed.

action_items: Replace SessionEnd.freeze_snapshot: dict with a strict Pydantic model, reject unknown/missing/negative/non-finite values, enforce end_time between start and request time, and recompute/verify duration and monetary values server-side (or use a signed server snapshot token).

If a current frame exists, auto-close it at the accepted snapshot end_time and ensure sum(frame amounts) equals the frozen table_amount; do not mutate the session before validating the complete end request.
Unset legacy preview_* keys in stored sessions or strip them from all session GET/list responses.
Address the documented auth playbook gaps separately when auth hardening is in scope.
Move Login navigation out of render and address Dashboard Recharts negative-size console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: SessionEnd.freeze_snapshot uses Optional[dict], bypassing Pydantic field validation; /end accepts arbitrary billing authority from any manage_sessions client.

end_session mutates and persists the running frame before payment/snapshot validation. A later 400 can therefore partially alter an otherwise active session, and snapshot-time consistency is impossible with the current ordering.
server.py is about 1400 lines, above the 700-line maintainability threshold; split auth, sessions, reports, and expenses into focused modules.
Login.jsx still navigates during render, reproducing React's Cannot update BrowserRouter while rendering Login warning.

success_rate.backend: 94% (33/33 requested/regression tests passed; 0/2 added integrity edge tests passed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested ephemeral reopen, backdrop/X cancel, split confirm, sticky footer, and Bill snapshot flows

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Iter7 API/UI sessions and snack orders. Normal test sessions were completed. The tampered-snapshot reproduction intentionally persisted one negative completed test invoice/payment. Two unrelated legacy active sessions with preview_* data pre-existed. Staff permissions were restored to manage_sessions=true only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core iteration-7 behavior is verified. UI first snapshot was 1s/₹0.13 plus Coke, reopened to 6s/₹0.50, backdrop close worked, and a later split confirm sent the exact freeze_snapshot; Bill matched. Retest the two failing TestIteration7SnapshotIntegrity tests after backend validation/frame-time fixes. Missing data-testid hooks were added only for Sessions modal backdrop/close/content and Bill table charge.
rca_of_the_issue: The core stale-state bug is fixed because finalize-preview no longer writes preview_* and the modal owns each response snapshot. Remaining integrity defects share a trust/ordering cause: freeze_snapshot is accepted as an arbitrary client dict, and current_frame is closed/persisted at wall-clock now before snapshot and payment validation. Use a validated or signed snapshot and make end processing validation-first and atomic at one accepted timestamp.
